Rhea Das: Fyi - Omega Labs ramped vector indexing overnight, noticed a sharp token spend jump. Need a one-slide QBR-ready summary + a short customer note. cc @Tom
Tom Becker: Looking at numbers. 24h burn = $8.4k, projected 30d at current = $252k (their historical avg ~ $40k). Credits left = $22k, retainer = $20k/mo, retainer expiry in 14 days. :grimacing:
Luis Moreno: Any breakdown? indexer vs query? Also what model are they using for embeddings?
Tom Becker: Indexing = 70% of the cost, query = 20%, misc = 10%. Using open-embed-fp16 with concurrency 10 for indexer. Average sequence length ~ 1,100 tokens.
Rhea Das: They flipped concurrency to speed migration. They told CS speed > cost. We should still propose tuned options and a safety-net.
Luis Moreno: Mitigation options for the slide: (1) temporary pause/scale-down of indexer, (2) swap indexer->quantized model, (3) enable chunked batching during ingestion.
Tom Becker: Quick scenario forecast for slide: status_quo = $252k, quantize+batching = $128k, pause-heavy-indexing = $62k. Note: pause impacts migration SLA.
Rhea Das: Need a 2-sentence customer-friendly note: empathetic + offer 30m enablement to tune concurrency and set up alerts. Also include a recommended safety-net policy.
Luis Moreno: Draft safety-net policy snippet for QBR (YAML): ```yaml
policy: omega_budget_guard
soft_usd: 20000
hard_usd: 30000
soft_action: notify-cs + warn-customer
hard_action: reduce-indexer-concurrency + swap-to-quantized-embed
```
Luis Moreno: Ops rollback CLI for runbook: ```bash
# switch indexer to quantized variant & lower concurrency
rwctl accounts set-model --account OMEGA --route embeddings --model open-embed-q4-8bit --batch-size 64
rwctl jobs update --account OMEGA --job indexer --concurrency 2
# emergency pause
rwctl jobs pause --account OMEGA --job indexer
# revert
rwctl jobs resume --account OMEGA --job indexer
rwctl accounts set-model --account OMEGA --route embeddings --model open-embed-fp16 --batch-size 256
```
billing-bot: Account OMEGA: credits_remaining=22000, monthly_retainer=20000, retainer_expiry=2026-04-07, auto_renew=false. ALERT: crossed 60% credits at 1763999900.
Rhea Das: Action items: Tom - paste the three scenario numbers into the QBR slide + tiny sparkline. Luis - prepare the 30m enablement blurb and the one-paragraph customer note. I'll coordinate with AE on a short staged commit ask. Meeting to finalize at 14:30.
Tom Becker: Will upload numbers and a small runway sparkline link by EOD.
Luis Moreno: Enablement blurb: "30-minute ingest optimization session: we will tune indexing concurrency, enable batching and model fallbacks, and provide a 10-day monitoring window with rollback support."
Rhea Das: Perfect. Also request the customer share 2 example flows where latency matters so we can avoid regressing UX when batching. Luis please collect during enablement.
Tom Becker: See you at 14:30. :thumbsup:
